title: Selected GR3 Belgian roadside/nature-grass case evidence
citation: Laub, K. et al. (2016). GR3 Project: Grass to Green Gas — final project report. Published 10 March 2016, printed pp. 25 and 27.
authors: Katharina Laub; Joachim Pertagnol; Lies Bamelis; Lorie Hamilton; Federico Correales; David Bolzonella; Robert Gruwez; Alain de Vocht; Ramon Pasman; Achim Kaiser; Michael Köttner; Erik Meers; Reinhart van Poucke; Willem Boeve; Santino di Beradino
geography: Limburg, Belgium (Noord Limburg case) and Zaventem–Boutersem, Belgium (Brussels Airport case)
rights_status: No explicit open license identified in the report. Only concise reported facts are transcribed with attribution; the report itself is not redistributed.
extraction_method: Factual transcription of specified case descriptions and reported case calculations; numeric separators are interpreted as European thousands separators only where noted in row limitations. No unreported conversions or recalculations.
limitations: Historical Belgian case study in a 2016 European project report; not current Dutch roadside supply, not GreenHub measurements, and not a runtime default. No exact collection year, sampling protocol, or site-level uncertainty is supplied unless the record explicitly says otherwise.

The report summarizes several business cases and pilot observations; not every number is a direct measurement. Per-record observation_status and basis distinguish estimates, case assumptions, contextual capacities, qualitative observations and unclear-basis ranges.
The reported biogas value is biogas (not methane) per fresh tonne; methane content and gas reference conditions are absent.
The report's stated wet-digester particle size <1 mm is reproduced verbatim and flagged for checking before any use.
No source values change GreenHub defaults, calculations, or scenario results.
